name: AXM Recovery & Rollback Center
actions: configure an in-process private snapshot schedule
preview and apply a confirmed restore rollback
summary: Create verified private snapshots, bind selective restore previews to both snapshot and current bytes, and roll applied restores back through a second preview and safety-copy boundary.
notes: Restore and rollback both require a fresh exact preview, recovery.apply permission, exact typed confirmation, and a safety copy. Scheduling is an in-process timer while the Workshop server runs; it does not install an OS task. Nothing restores, rolls back, deletes, uploads, or promotes automatically.
